AN EXPLORATION IN MOTION BUILT TO BE EXPERIENCED
THE THINKING BENEATH THE THRILL

Engineered to
challenge convention.

01

Electric propulsion

Electric motors convert stored battery energy into motion. There is no combustion engine under the front hood. The assembly in this experience is an illustrative cutaway.

02

Aerodynamic thinking

A low silhouette, controlled airflow, a rear wing and an underbody diffuser form the visual language of this performance study.

03

Cold-gas imagination

The cinematic sequence explores the Roadster's thruster idea with visible air plumes, an inverted ramp run and a controlled roll. This animation is an artistic reconstruction, not a physics simulator.

04

The human connection

An opening door, a moving camera, a sculpted steering yoke and a focused display bring you from the exterior into an imagined cockpit.

Independent fan concept by Yash Patel. The reference exterior is “Tesla Roadster 3D” by The3DBoss, displayed through the creator’s official Sketchfab embed. The separate motion prototype uses original artistic geometry, mechanisms, interior and sound. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla or SpaceX. No production specifications are claimed.

DESIGN + DEVELOPMENT

A concept.
Without limits.

A cinematic Roadster study by Yash Patel, combining real-time 3D, interactive product storytelling and original synthesized sound design.

The exterior showcase displays “Tesla Roadster 3D” by The3DBoss ↗ through its official Sketchfab viewer. This model is the creator’s work and has no interior.

The separate motion prototype is Yash’s original interaction study with a stylized vehicle. Its hood, cockpit and stunt controls do not operate the reference model.
